description: This file defines a ControlChannel class responsible for managing a control communication channel within an application. It includes handling connection states, configuration, health checks, sending system events, processing incoming events and push notifications, and error handling. It also defines related data structures, error types, and event handling logic relevant to control communication.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the control communication channel, including connection states, configuration, messaging, and event handling within the application.

methods.name: configure()
methods.description: Configures the control channel in local mode, refreshing the endpoint.

methods.name: configure(mode: Mode)
methods.description: Configures the control channel in specified mode, either local or remote.

methods.name: refreshEndpoint(reason: String)
methods.description: Attempts to establish a gateway connection and update the control channel state.

methods.name: disconnect()
methods.description: Shuts down the gateway connection and resets connection state for the control channel.

methods.name: health(timeout: TimeInterval?)
methods.description: Performs a health check of the control channel, returning diagnostic data or error.

methods.name: lastHeartbeat()
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent heartbeat event from the control channel.

methods.name: request(method: String, params: [String: AnyHashable]?, timeoutMs: Double?)
methods.description: Sends a request over the control channel with specified method, parameters, and timeout.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent(_ text: String, params: [String: AnyHashable])
methods.description: Sends a system event message via the control channel.
